purpose: Professional actor/composer/director portfolio and practical shoot planning

provenance.note: 10 actionable rules. Only explicitly recalled reference numbers are attached. Not a frame-by-frame audit of unavailable video files.

rules.name: Художественная визитка
rules.effect: Build 30–60-second mini-film with protagonist goal, obstacle, escalation, turn, actor range and author-reviewed dialogue; never pass off fiction as biography.

rules.name: Match Cut
rules.effect: Hold identical framing, pose and screen position between takes; switch costume, emotional task and movement. No unapproved identity manipulation.

rules.name: Top-down Flat lay
rules.effect: Tell a comic situation through hands and props from overhead; the comic reveal is the gap between planned and actual action.

rules.name: Associative intercut
rules.effect: Suggest alternation of face/reaction and reviewed object inserts (paper, candle, flame) when an emotional causal link exists; no fabricated footage or auto-insert.

rules.name: Dramatic rim light
rules.effect: Recommend controlled back/rim light to separate silhouette, only when safe and available; do not claim actual measurements.

rules.name: Interview 45-degree key
rules.effect: Recommend soft key at ~45 degrees and slightly above eye line; fill is optional and the face must remain legible.

rules.name: Second-phone monitor
rules.effect: Second phone may serve as monitoring aid using supported camera preview or local link; verify compatibility, delay and privacy. Never assume remote screen control.

rules.name: Signaling theory
rules.effect: Review whether tangible observable competence in acting, music or direction is demonstrated rather than claimed; weak evidence despite virality -> WARNING.

rules.name: 90/90/1 protected practice
rules.effect: Choose one important professional result for 90 days, protect up to 90 minutes daily for focused work without accumulating missed-day debt. Adapt to real schedule.

rules.name: Music sync proof and rights
rules.effect: Track genre, mood, length, stems, rights owner, licensed/owned/unknown rights, accessible HTTPS links and cue metadata; do not claim cleared licensing without evidence.

guardrails.editing: Suggestion only; insert only uploaded verified cleared media after author review
guardrails.music: Rights owner is a statement by the author, not legal clearance
guardrails.actor: Portfolio script/shot list is a draft until approved
